definitions.explanation: A self-made scientist who overcame poverty and a childhood hand injury to research syphilis and yellow fever internationally, dying of yellow fever himself while researching it in Africa. A model of perseverance taught to schoolchildren, and the face of the ¥1,000 note from 2004 to 2024.

examples.japanese: {野口英世|のぐちひでよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細菌学者|さいきんがくしゃ}だった。
{野口英世|のぐちひでよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黄熱病|おうねつびょう}→黄熱病：23735_ounetsubyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研究中|けんきゅうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: Noguchi Hideyo died while researching yellow fever.

examples.japanese: {野口英世|のぐちひでよ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幼少期|ようしょうき}→幼少期：21168_youshouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{左手|ひだりて}→左手：10975_hidarite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大|おお}やけどを⟦{負|お}った→負う：02017_ou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{苦学|くがく}して⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Noguchi Hideyo suffered a severe burn to his left hand as a child, but he studied hard against the odds and became a doctor.

notes:
His childhood struggle after a severe hand burn, and the poverty he studied his way out of, made him a standard example of perseverance in Japanese school textbooks.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {野口英世|のぐちひでよ}のように⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧: to work as hard as Noguchi Hideyo did (said admiringly)

CULTURAL NOTE:
He researched syphilis and yellow fever, eventually dying of yellow fever while studying it in Ghana. His portrait appeared on the ¥1,000 note from 2004 to 2024, when he was replaced by {北里柴三郎|きたさとしばさぶろう} in the redesign.
